contexts.text: (They are punished) until they are struck with terror and horror at deceiving by false speeches.
The delight of their life to reason from falsities, and thus to deceive and seduce others.
Under Deceit, see this reference, and at AE 866. AE 866:3. LJPost 5.
They speak truths with the mouth, but falsify them... and thus deceive. Signified.
They who speak much about God, but care nothing about deceiving men... commit adultery with maidservants...
